messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected for /v1/generate across us-west-2. Trigger: 5xx-rate > 5% for 2m. PagerDuty: P12345.

maria_sre: Ack. I'm on it — paging now. @alex_runtime can you join?

alex_runtime: here. seeing a spike of 502/504 + occasional segfaults from model-runner on a subset of hosts (gpu-pool-13*). dumping recent logs now.

sam_prod: customers reporting increased latency + some timeouts. I have a ticket open with a high-touch customer (AcmeCorp). Notified CS already.

indra_prod: quick summary from metrics: error-rate jumps at ~17:06 UTC. p50 latency up from 120ms -> 420ms. p95 increased to ~2.3s. request volume steady.

alex_runtime: logs snippet:
```
2024-11-28T17:06:18Z model-runner[pid=2345]: SIGSEGV at 0x7f9b2a3c
E RUNTIME: segfault while executing quant_kernel_x8
stack: 0x7f9b2a3c -> 0x7f9b1f00
OOM? rss=13.2GB vmem=48GB on node gpu-13
```
Looks like a kernel/quant path crash + OOMs on same nodes.

maria_sre: good catch. @ops-bot can we isolate/cordon the affected nodes (gpu-pool-13*) and route traffic away?

ops-bot: command queued: `k8s cordon gpu-13-{0..3}`. Starting graceful drain with 30s timeout.

alex_runtime: doing a quick grep — crashes correlate with longer sequences (>1024 tokens) and batched requests. Kernel path `quant_kernel_x8` is used for int8 runs.

maria_sre: mitigation plan (short): 1) route new prod traffic to healthy pool (gpu-pool-21) 2) disable int8 kernel fallback to force fp16 on affected model variant 3) reduce concurrency/batching until we stabilize 4) collect core/gcore from one failed node for analysis.

sam_prod: Routing now: updating smart-router to prefer region=us-west-2 pool=21. Will allow 2min for propagation. Notifying customers in impacted seg.

cs_amy: Thx. I'll send a short status email to the affected customers (AcmeCorp, FinApps, Chatly) with ETA ~30-60m while we mitigate.

alex_runtime: command to toggle kernel fallback on runtime: 
```
POST /admin/runtime/flags {"quant_fallback_enabled": false}
```
Applying on canary first.

ops-bot: apply on canary runtime: runtime-canary-7... ok. Metrics show canary 5xx down to baseline.

maria_sre: good. roll to remaining runtimes sequentially with 1 node at a time. Keep batching disabled for now: `set batching.max_batch_size=1`.

indra_prod: set batching config applied to fleets in us-west-2. We'll monitor QPS vs CPU/GPU utilization.

alex_runtime: grabbed gcore and heap profile from gpu-13-1. Uploading to /tmp/incident-dump.tgz. Attaching traces: suspect edge in quant kernel when KV cache grows beyond a threshold and a memcpy hits null pointer.

maria_sre: any immediate need to evict the rest of the nodes? We should avoid full pool reboot unless necessary. Draining seems to have helped.

sam_prod: After routing changes + kernel toggle, error-rate dropped from 6.8% -> 0.9% over 3 minutes. p95 back to ~380ms. Will keep monitoring.

alex_runtime: we still saw a synthetic crash on a node we didn't cordon (gpu-13-4) but it's isolated. I think the rollout to disable quant path fixed the recurrent crashes. We'll do a runtime patch to add null-check and bounds check in quant_kernel.

maria_sre: patch plan: hotfix to runtime canary, test with stress-tool (long sequences, variable batch). If green, roll to prod. If not, fallback permanently to fp16 profile for affected models.

ops-bot: hotfix build queued: build/rt-hotfix-quant-nullcheck #472. Canary deploy starting.

cs_amy: customers updated: emailed list, posted incident in status site with initial remediation steps and ETA 1h. Will update when we have root cause.

indra_prod: quick customer impact note: ~4% of requests from paid customers in us-west-2 failed between 17:06-17:12. No data leakage reported. Logs show 5xx responses returned by runtime.

maria_sre: are there any associated billing anomalies?

sam_prod: billing unaffected; we blocked retries for affected routes to prevent billing storms.

alex_runtime: can reproduce locally with stress harness: sequence length 2048 + batch size 8 on int8 path -> crash. Confirmed null ptr at plane 0 offset when KV page grows. Patch ready.

maria_sre: apply hotfix to canary only. If canary stable for 10m, we roll to one half of pool then monitor. If no regressions for 20m, full roll.

ops-bot: canary hotfix deployed. health checks passing.

sam_prod: metrics after canary: 5xx down to 0.4% in canary, remainder pools still at ~0.9% since earlier routing. Maintaining traffic shift for 15m.

cs_amy: customer comms updated: sent follow-up noting mitigation and that engineering is actively rolling out a fix.

maria_sre: preparing handoff. Summary for next on-call (@oncall-next): root cause appears to be a null pointer in quant_kernel_x8 triggered during large-batch, long-seq inference, causing segfaults and occasional OOM. Mitigations applied: traffic reroute to healthy pool, cordoned + drained problematic nodes, disabled quant fallback (force fp16), disabled batching, deployed hotfix to canary. Current status: error-rate returned close to baseline, hotfix canary healthy, rolling to prod. Customer impact: several paid customers saw intermittent 5xx/timeouts for ~6 mins. CS notified.

oncall-next: taking handoff. any open actions?

maria_sre: follow-ups: 1) continue rollout of hotfix to remaining pools, 2) postmortem ticket (INC-2024-768) to track RCA + KCS updates, 3) add stress tests for int8 path with KV growth, 4) consider circuit-breaker for long sequences/batching combos until quant path validated.

alex_runtime: I'll push the full rollout in 10m if no regressions. Also will prepare a more detailed trace and PR for the kernel guard.

oncall-next: acknowledged. I'll monitor overnight and escalate if regressions occur.

maria_sre: closing the incident channel in 30m if metrics stable. Great work team — quick detection and rollback. :tada:

cs_amy: adding customer follow-up note to ticket.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity downgraded to mitigated at 17:27 UTC.
